properties.title: Capanna di Sciora CAS
properties.description: The Sciora Hut, located in an idyllic setting at the foot of the Sciora group in Val Bregaglia, can now (since July 2025 ) be reached via the new panoramic trail, which starts in Bondo and crosses four suspension bridges from which you can enjoy spectacular views of the surrounding mountains and the north-east face of Pizzo Badile. The area also offers more or less challenging climbing routes. It is also an excellent destination for hikers; the ‘Sentiero Alpino Bregaglia’ invites you to enjoy unforgettable excursions, such as the crossing of the Passo Cacciabella Sud to the Capanna da l'Albigna.
